george.blurb: Cryo skirmisher. Frost shots slow the front line; ice bursts freeze nearby packs.
george.strengths: Highest mobility. Slows enemies with every shot. Frost Nova freezes packs; Blizzard controls a wide area.
george.weakness: Thin armor and low burst damage. Cold-resistant enemies blunt his damage and slows.

abilityBlurb.0: Rapid frost shots slow enemies by up to 45% for 1.2s.
abilityBlurb.1: I-frame slide; frost at the destination deals 24 cold and freezes for 0.6s.
abilityBlurb.2: 4-radius nova deals 70 cold, freezes for 1.2s, and slows for 3s.
abilityBlurb.3: 3s veil: speed, fire rate, damage, and 80% resist.
abilityBlurb.4: 5s blizzard: all enemies within 7 radius take 18 cold and briefly freeze every 0.5s.

leela.blurb: Electric skirmisher. Every shot chains. Storms tear apart anything that gets close.
leela.strengths: Highest mobility. Auto-attacks chain to two nearby targets. Storm Surge zaps every enemy in a wide ring for several seconds.
leela.weakness: Thin armor — eats hits at midrange. Electric-resistant titans absorb the kit.

abilityBlurb.0: Fast electric zap. Each shot chains to two nearby targets.
abilityBlurb.1: I-frame dash; end arcs hit 3 enemies for 14 electric.
abilityBlurb.2: 4-radius electric pulse, then 4 chain hops for 20 each.
abilityBlurb.3: 3s veil: speed, fire rate, damage, and 50% resist.
abilityBlurb.4: 3s storm: 4 electric arcs every 0.5s inside 7 radius.

mike.blurb: Close-range flame mech. Heavy per-shot splash plus burn DoT — turns packs into bonfires.
mike.strengths: Biggest auto-attack splash of any robot. Ignition doubles fire rate. Inferno Ring washes flame waves out in every direction.
mike.weakness: Shortest engagement range. Para and armored matriarchs vent flame at ≤0.5×.

abilityBlurb.0: Short-range flame splash. Every shot hits a small pack.
abilityBlurb.1: I-frame dash that leaves a 2.6s burning coal trail.
abilityBlurb.3: 4s ignition: x2 fire rate, +30% damage, 35% resist.
abilityBlurb.4: 3 expanding flame rings, 95 each, plus burn.

stan.blurb: Kinetic gunner. Rapid bullet fans rake packs; Bullet Hell blankets a cone with sustained fire.
stan.strengths: Hits every enemy in a bullet cone. Crossfire clears close packs. Bullet Hell rewards lining up a crowded lane.
stan.weakness: Slow movement. Enemies behind him escape the cone. Kinetic-resistant armor reduces his damage.

abilityBlurb.0: Rapid kinetic bullet fans hit all enemies in a narrow cone.
abilityBlurb.1: Short i-frame roll to line up the next firing lane.
abilityBlurb.2: Wide 6-range bullet fan deals 120 kinetic and pushes enemies back.
abilityBlurb.3: 5s overdrive: +80% fire rate, +15% damage, 50% resist, slower movement.
abilityBlurb.4: 3.5s fixed-direction barrage: 24 kinetic every 0.14s in an 11-range cone. Move or dash to cancel.
